title: Get apps hashes
description: This is an API function that returns matching mobile app fingerprints as a response to users based on specified parameters.  The basis of the function is to process the parameters specified by the user and the necessary database query is created. Subsequently, the data are processed into the necessary format and sent as a response to the user.
pythonCode:
import requests
import json
import pandas as pd
import os

API_URL = "http://hashapp.netology.sk:8081/api/get-app-hashes"

auth_key = "C2wazCNeZE403zlXwwdi5KARfOCUYQ"

apps = [
    {"package_name":"com.discord", "version":"216.14"},
    {"package_name":"com.spotify.music", "version":"8.9.14.543"},
]

parameters = {
    "auth_key": auth_key,
    "apps": apps
}

response = requests.post(API_URL, json=parameters)
json_response = json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2)

print(json_response)

title: Get apps from hashes
description: This functionality provides the  information regarding applications based on the entered fingerprints for user. The procedure searches the database system for all records matching the fingerprints entered by the user. From the matching records, it extracts application information, such as application name, package name, or version, and associates it with the given fingerprint. If an application fingerprint matches multiple applications, an application field is associated with the fingerprint. The results are presented to the user in the form of a JSON object. If no record exists in the database for the corresponding fingerprint, it is assigned a value of Null.
pythonCode:
import requests
import json
import pandas as pd

API_URL = "http://hashapp.netology.sk:8081/api/get-apps-from-hashes"

title: Create hash from APK
description: This functionality provides the user`s ability to create new mobile app fingerprints based on an APK file using an API. The function processes and stores the data entered by the user - this is mainly the APK files needed to create the fingerprints. It then starts the fingerprint creation process, for each of the APK files. Once the request is successfully queued, the user is notified when processing begins. The results are not presented to the user immediately after the generation is complete, as in the case of the web interface. To find out the results, a function call is required to find out the application fingerprints based on the specified parameters. This approach is necessary because requests are sequentially queued and then they are sequentially selected and processed independently of the execution of other activities.
pythonCode:
import requests
import json
import pandas as pd
import os

API_URL = "http://hashapp.netology.sk:8081/api/create-hash-from-apk"

auth_key = "C2wazCNeZE403zlXwwdi5KARfOCUYQ"

apk_file = open("./api_tests/files/discord.apk", "rb")

parameters = {
    "auth_key": auth_key,
}

response = requests.post(API_URL, data=parameters, files={"apk_file": apk_file})
json_response = json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2)

print(json_response)
expectedOutput: Task for create hashes from APK (discord.apk) was added to queue.

title: Create hash from package name
description: This part of API provides the user`s ability to create new mobile app fingerprints based on the name of the mobile app`s package. The function processes the app names entered by the user and then starts the fingerprint creation process, which includes a process to ensure that the APK file for the app is automatically downloaded. Similar to creating apps via APK files, the results will not be presented to the user immediately after the generation is complete.

title: Create hash from PCAP file
description: This API feature provides the user`s ability to create new mobile app fingerprints based on the PCAP file using the API. This is an extension of the registered user functionality, as only the administrator has the ability to create fingerprints using the PCAP file through the web interface. The function processes and stores the data provided by the user (these are the PCAP files, the application name, version, package name, or whether it is malware or not). The procedure for creating mobile apps fingerprints is then called. Unlike previous functions, where requests had to be stored in a queue, this is not necessary with this type of creation. The fingerprints are created synchronously, by calling the corresponding functions, and the user has the fingerprints available immediately after generation. The generated fingerprints are processed and represented as a JSON object, which is sent to the user as a response.
pythonCode:
import requests
import json
import pandas as pd
import os

API_URL = "http://hashapp.netology.sk:8081/api/create-hash-from-pcap"

}

json_response = json.dumps(response.json(), indent=2)

print(json_response)

title: Analzye NetFlow file
